passages.note: Assembly Floor concurrence vote where Gabriel appears in the Ayes list on SB 100, during an earlier Assembly term in this legislature.

passages.provision_quote: the quantities shall reflect reasonable progress in each of the intervening years sufficient to ensure that the procurement of electricity products from eligible renewable energy resources achieves 25 percent of retail sales by December 31, 2016, 33 percent by December 31, 2020, 44 percent by December 31, 2024, 52 percent by December 31, 2027, and 60 percent by December 31, 2030.
passages.note: The RPS program's binding procurement percentages with firm dates match rung 1's mandate-and-deadline clauses.

rows.reasoning: Gabriel voted Aye on SB 100 (2017-2018), the California Renewables Portfolio Standard Program, during an earlier Assembly term in this legislature. Its operative text binds retail sellers to a dated procurement schedule reaching 60 percent by December 31, 2030, which matches the rung text 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines' rather than any of the other rungs.
